newsitem.title: UK: UK's MEPC implements rationalisation plan.
newsitem.headline: UK's MEPC implements rationalisation plan.

text.p: MEPC Plc has agreed contracts to outsource the non-core facilities management of 340 properties to Nelson Bakewell and Jones Lang Wootton, MEPC said in a statement on Wednesday.
The change, which takes effect from May 27, is part of the property company's plan to concentrate efforts on the areas that add the greatest value.
MEPC's facilities management will focus on its major offices, shopping centres and industrial estates, which represent some 1.3 billion stg of value.
